question: A traveler booked a five-hour flight only a week before departure. Can I approve a seat above basic economy?
canonical_question: What is the policy for booking a seat above basic economy for a five-hour flight booked less than 14 days in advance?
reference_canonical_question: What class of service is allowed for a flight booked fewer than 14 days in advance?
ground_truth: For a 3-to-6-hour flight booked fewer than 14 days in advance, Economy Plus / Premium Economy is the allowed class of service. Bookings made fewer than 14 days in advance also require a documented business justification in the expense report notes.

question: The employee rented a car for a 180-mile round trip because they did not want to use their own vehicle. Is a rental allowed instead of mileage?
canonical_question: Under what circumstances can rental vehicles be used instead of personal-vehicle mileage?
reference_canonical_question: Under what circumstances can rental vehicles be used instead of personal-vehicle mileage?
ground_truth: Rental vehicles may be used instead of personal-vehicle mileage when total round-trip mileage exceeds 150 miles or when a personal vehicle is unavailable. Rentals must be economy or standard class unless three or more employees travel together, in which case a mid-size or larger vehicle may be booked.

question: A Finance Admin already signed off on a high-value report and is now assigned to the post-payment spot check. Is that okay?
canonical_question: What are the policies regarding audit sampling review conducted by Finance Admins?
ground_truth: Sampled reports are reviewed by Finance Admin staff not involved in the original approval. The Finance Admin conducting an audit sampling review must not be the same Finance Admin who approved the report when staffing allows; if only one Finance Admin is available, the review is escalated to a second reviewing entity outside the normal approval chain.

question: Someone paid a visa fee and required travel shots for an overseas client trip. Are those reimbursable, and what about renewing their passport?
canonical_question: What are the reimbursement policies for international trip expenses?
reference_canonical_question: What costs are reimbursable for an approved international trip?
ground_truth: Visa application fees and business-required vaccinations are fully reimbursable with receipt when required for an approved international trip. Passport renewal costs are not reimbursable because a valid passport is treated as a standing employee responsibility rather than a per-trip cost.

question: A fully remote employee bought a monitor and also wants the monthly internet allowance. What limits apply, and do they need receipts?
canonical_question: What are the reimbursement policies for home office equipment and internet expenses?
reference_canonical_question: What are the caps for home office equipment and internet service benefits?
ground_truth: Home office equipment such as a monitor is capped at $500 as a one-time per-employee benefit that resets every 3 years. Internet service is capped at $50 monthly. Monthly internet and utility stipend amounts are claimed through the standard expense report process and do not require a receipt below the general receipt threshold; the one-time equipment cap always requires an itemized receipt regardless of amount.
